title: Praxis graph binding
description: aiws-graph-binding/1 (GRAPH-BINDING.md): what each dispatched node of one finite-v1 graph revision runs under Praxis. One immutable document per binding revision. The document is closed: Praxis refuses a field it does not know. This schema checks shape only; the checks against the graph, the contract and the host are in GRAPH-BINDING.md.

graphBindingId.description: The binding's identity. Distinct from a protocol binding's bindingId.

graphBindingRevision.description: Append-only revision of this binding. A run keeps the revision it attached.

graphId.description: The finite-v1 Graph.id this binding targets.

graphRevision.description: The finite-v1 Graph.revision this binding targets.

graphDigest.description: The SDK digest of the target Graph record exactly as registered: 'sha256:' and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (TypeScript digest from @aiws/sdk/sqlite, Rust aiws_sdk::digest, Python aiws.digest).

costUnit.description: Must equal the limits ledger's cost unit (COST_UNIT_MISMATCH at attach).

maxTotalCost.description: The RUN scope's cost bound in costUnit. Absent: the RUN scope inherits. Not above Contract.budget (LIMIT_CONFIGURATION_INVALID at attach).

contextPolicy.description: The run's one immutable context policy, received by every AGENT node.

nodes.description: One entry per dispatched node (TASK, LOOP and COMPENSATION), keyed by node id. Completeness and node kinds are checked against the graph at submission.

LedgerAmount.description: An amount in the ledger cost unit: a canonical unsigned decimal integer of at most 30 digits.

Entry.description: What one node runs, by executionKind. A TASK entry's executionKind must equal the node's config.executionKind (BINDING_KIND_MISMATCH); a LOOP or COMPENSATION entry chooses it.

AgentEntry.description: A node run by a catalog agent. The capability digest is pinned per run in the node assignment, never here.

requirements.description: Only requirements above the runner's minimums, which are re-derived and never stored.

ToolEntry.description: A node run as one admitted operation on a registered protocol binding. The protocol bindingRevision and capabilityDigest are pinned per run; the authority grant comes from the contract and grants, never from the binding.

payload.description: A static, reviewed JSON value. Submission checks it against the node's inputSchema.

FunctionEntry.description: Well formed, but submission refuses it (EXECUTION_KIND_UNSUPPORTED) until FUNCTION execution is decided; its fields will be added within aiws-graph-binding/1.

HumanEntry.description: Well formed, but submission refuses it (EXECUTION_KIND_UNSUPPORTED) until HUMAN execution is decided; its fields will be added within aiws-graph-binding/1.

Role.description: WORK, or VALIDATION: the entry's outcome is evidence for its criteria (SUCCEEDED is PASS, FAILED is FAIL, UNKNOWN is INCONCLUSIVE). A WORK outcome never feeds verify.

Criteria.description: Contract criterion names (CRITERIA_UNKNOWN at attach for a name the contract lacks).

RoleCriteria.description: A VALIDATION entry carries criteria; a WORK entry carries none.

AgentId.description: A catalog agent id: nonblank, at most 256 characters, no control characters and no surrounding white space.

Command.description: One command as an argument array: the program first, nonempty; no NUL in any argument.

OutputPath.description: A relative file path with '/' separators: no empty, '.' or '..' segment, no leading '/', and no backslash, colon or NUL.

Exposure.description: BOUNDED: the allowance every attempt reserves whole and a stop threshold, in the cost unit; submission also requires stopThreshold <= allowance. NOT_APPLICABLE: only for an agent whose model set is empty.

MaxAttempts.description: Optional; never above Contract.maxAttempts (checked at attach).

TaskMs.description: One attempt's maximum duration in milliseconds, within the local Node timer range.

ContextPolicy.description: coding-context-policy/1. Submission also requires reference names unique across both lists and, with a summary, basedOn equal to the set of referenced artifact digests.

ModelCapabilityName.$comment: One name per model confinement condition, plus the optional served-model-reported capability a human may require for a run.
